title: Increasing Triplet Exists
summary: Return whether three indices form a strictly increasing subsequence.
statement: Return whether three indices form a strictly increasing subsequence. Implement `increasing_triplet_exists` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
reference_solution:
def increasing_triplet_exists(nums):
    first = second = float('inf')
    for value in nums:
        if value <= first: first = value
        elif value <= second: second = value
        else: return True
    return False
brute_force_solution:
def increasing_triplet_exists(nums):
    first = second = float('inf')
    for value in nums:
        if value <= first: first = value
        elif value <= second: second = value
        else: return True
    return False
